CustomField.label: Logo.dev Publishable Token
CustomField.description: Publishable (pk_) token for logo.dev, used by BrandScraper to build high-res primary + secondary brand logo image URLs (img.logo.dev). Safe to ship: it is a client-side publishable key, not a secret. Ships with the package so SDOs work out of the box; override per-org here if the team ever needs its own token. Blank = fall back to the DuckDuckGo favicon.
